name: inspira-gradient-button

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows both buttons evenly lit with the rainbow and blue-pink rings at full colour.

tagline: Two dark buttons with a glowing rainbow border that slowly turns.
summary: A pill or rounded button wrapped in a blurred conic gradient that rotates, so the outline cycles through colours. Fill, radius, border width and speed are configurable.
appearance: Two dark buttons sit on a black stage. One is a rounded rectangle and one a full pill; each is ringed by a bright, soft gradient border, rainbow on the left and blue-violet-pink on the right, holding white text.
behaviour: The gradient ring rotates continuously around each button, so the border colours drift and glow while the button itself stays put and the label stays fixed.
demo_content: Get early access and Explore templates.
use_when: A primary call to action needs to stand out on a dark page without changing its layout.
avoid_when: The blurred glow is soft and imprecise, and the busy colours can clash with a strict brand palette.
customise: colors, duration, borderWidth, borderRadius, blur and bgColor are props; the conic keyframe and inner padding are fixed.
weight_why: A single pseudo-element rotating a blurred conic gradient with CSS.

a11y.note: It is a native button with a real text label, but the border animation never stops and no focus style is set.

polish_why: Bright and smooth, but it is a familiar rainbow-border trick with plain labels.
